## Rules

| Rule ID | Strength | Phases | Probe | Assertion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `figure.width.single` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `77` mm |
| `figure.width.double` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `160` mm |
| `font.family` | required | live | `font.families.effective` | subset `Times, Times New Roman, serif` |
| `font.size.min` | inferred | live | `font.size.min_pt` | gte `9` pt |
| `font.size.target` | recommended | live | `font.size.max_pt` | eq `10` pt |
| `font.pdf.embedding.required` | required | file | `pdf.unembedded_font_count` | eq `0` |
| `export.formats.vector` | recommended | file | `artifact.format` | in `pdf` |
